objective_boundary: The sole performance criterion, if an authorized test is later run, is ex-post cost-aware rolling-five-year TWRR at or above 5%. It is not a guarantee, forecast, probability, annual floor or action.

listed_fund_hypothesis.decision_frequency: first observed session of a calendar month after close
listed_fund_hypothesis.information_lag: use information available through the preceding observed close; marked target cannot become effective until the following observed session
listed_fund_hypothesis.risk_filter: positive 252-observation total-return momentum and total-return level above its 200-observation moving average
listed_fund_hypothesis.selection: rank eligible 510300/510880/518880 and select at most two; apply a frozen overlap-risk cluster rule before any mapping
listed_fund_hypothesis.test_mapping: An exploratory post-source public daily-bar diagnostic mechanically used 50% combined selected risk sleeves and 511010 for the remainder. Its unresolved adjustment basis makes it non-admissible; a formal total-return test must be pre-registered independently before results are viewed.
listed_fund_hypothesis.event_accounting: Record each distribution, interest, coupon, redemption, split and correction exactly once at its actual available/settled time. No automatic reinvestment is assumed.
listed_fund_hypothesis.execution: Use dated price/NAV, broker fee, tax, T+1, spread/depth, halt, limit and no-fill inputs. A missing input leaves the candidate ineligible.

commodity_futures_hypothesis.instrument_basis: actual listed contracts only; continuous series are disallowed for P&L or roll proof
commodity_futures_hypothesis.signal: weighted time-series momentum using 21/63/126 prior observed settlement returns with weights 0.45/0.35/0.20; 60-session volatility estimate
commodity_futures_hypothesis.contract_gate: On each decision date require a verified actual contract code, lifecycle/last-trade record, delivery buffer, price-limit and trading-status record, volume/open-interest threshold, margin/fee record, position-limit record and broker-route confirmation.
commodity_futures_hypothesis.risk_mapping: Use unitized-NAV volatility sizing with pre-approved portfolio/group/instrument risk limits. No numeric limit has been approved in this draft.
commodity_futures_hypothesis.roll_and_failure: Choose and roll only between contemporaneously eligible actual contracts under a pre-registered rule. If price limit, suspension, missing liquidity or delivery restriction prevents a fill, record no-fill and retain the risk; do not manufacture a transaction.
commodity_futures_hypothesis.accounting: Mark variation P&L at observed daily settlement; separately record collateral convention, exchange/broker fees, spread/impact and roll difference. No automatic reinvestment assumption is used.

common_freeze_gates: Authorized data entitlement, raw archive, as_of/available_at timestamps and revision treatment.
Predeclared eligible universe, substitutions, ties, calendar, lookbacks, costs, taxes and no-fill behavior.
Complete event ledger for listed funds and actual-contract lifecycle/limit/margin history for futures.
Development/holdout separation plus every complete rolling-five-year endpoint disclosed.
Current product/contract facts, broker route, suitability, liquidity and independent R0/R1/risk review.
current_decision: No rule is frozen, tested as formal total return or approved for action.
